title: Mishitha and Lohit Medal at Regional Boxing Championship
body:
CISCE Regional Boxing Championship, Karnataka and Goa, held at De Paul International Residential School, Mysuru, on 14 September 2026.

Mishitha – Grade 10A
Secured 1st Place in the Under-17 category
Selected for the National Boxing Competition, to be held in Meerut on 28th September 2026

Lohit – Grade 9A
Secured 2nd Place in the Under-17 category

photos.alt: Mishitha and Lohit with medals at the CISCE Regional Boxing Championship in Mysuru
